name: Undamaged Venom Sac
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
I must have a fresh sample of the venom you brought me.  The spiders from which it was gathered must dwell in the Hinterlands -- hunt them until you find an undamaged venom sac and bring it to me.  You will find many spiders near the troll city of Shadra'Alor.

Do not tarry, adventurer, for the venom sac must be fresh when you deliver it.
narrative.objectives: Bring an Undamaged Venom Sac to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill.
narrative.offerRewardText: Oh, splendid! The venom is quite fresh and I'm sure very deadly. Thank you!
narrative.requestItemsText: Do you have the undamaged venom sac, adventurer?  I yearn to run experiments with its fresh venom, and have ordered a collection of small, terribly cute animals on which to test it!

chain.subtitle: 6 quests from level 43 to 55, 32,150 XP in all.

quests.name: Venom Bottles
quests.objectiveText: Bring a Venom Bottle to an apothecary in Tarren Mill.

quests.name: Undamaged Venom Sac
quests.objectiveText: Bring an Undamaged Venom Sac to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill.

quests.name: Consult Master Gadrin
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village.

quests.name: The Spider God
quests.objectiveText: Read from the Tablet of Theka to learn the name of the Witherbark spider god, then return to Master Gadrin.

quests.name: Summoning Shadra
quests.objectiveText: Defeat Shadra at the altar of Shadra'Alor, then bring her venom to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill.

quests.name: Venom to the Undercity
quests.objectiveText: Bring Faranell's Parcel to Master Apothecary Faranell in the Undercity.
